contract: Each required Shield test binds one minimal contract mutation (counterexample). The 19 pre-implemented-module bindings (baseline_events through m_impl_boundary) have been re-run against the real Devon-implemented M-IMPL code via the §12.5 protocol (apply patch → run bound test node → record killed/survived → reverse via git apply -R → fresh unpatched verification). All 19 are killed: each patch makes the bound test fail at a behavior assertion, and the fresh unpatched run passes. The 7 stub-targeting patch groups (doc_comment_classify, doc_comment_adjudicate, doc_comment_resume, doc_comment_quarantine, live_evidence_bind, live_evidence_write, release_evidence_checks) remain pending-implementation per §12.3: their bound tests target functions whose stubs still raise NotImplementedError, so no counterexample can be killed until Devon implements the routing that makes those stubs reachable.
